sisyphus.description: Primary orchestrator and senior software engineer. Use for high-level reasoning, research, and delegation.

sisyphus-junior.description: Lightweight orchestrator for mid-sized tasks and direct implementation coordination.

multimodal-looker.description: Specialized analyst for high-detail image, PDF, and file analysis. Use when you need to 'look' at an asset.

oracle.description: Strategic technical advisor for architecture, debugging hard problems, and deep reasoning.

librarian.description: Documentation and API specialist. Use to find implementation examples and official library docs.

metis.description: Pre-planning consultant. Analyzes requests for ambiguity and over-engineering before planning.

prometheus.description: Planning specialist. Creates detailed, atomic, executable work plans in .sisyphus/plans/.

hephaestus.description: Implementation specialist. Executes granular tasks with precision following architectural patterns.

atlas.description: Master orchestrator. Coordinates multi-step plans by delegating and verifying sub-agent work.

momus.description: Plan reviewer. Verifies that work plans are executable and references are valid.

explore.description: Codebase search specialist. Answers where things are implemented and finds code patterns.

settings.name: Default Model
settings.description: The default model to use for sub-agents and fallback tasks.
